messages:
ana (SI - Vertex): heads-up — during today's architecture review with RetailCo we're hitting a blocker for their air-gapped rollout. The marketplace image verification fails: policy requires OCI image signatures (cosign) and their edge nodes have an old TPM stack + UEFI lock that prevents the cosign verification helper from loading. Need options.

sam (PartnerEng): ouch. do you have the exact failure logs? is it a cosign runtime error or kernel/secureboot rejection? :thinking: we should loop in security.

ana (ana typo — but keep original): here: ```
2026-03-19T09:12:01Z INFO starting verifier
2026-03-19T09:12:01Z ERROR cosign: verification failed: syscall exec: "cosign-verify-helper": permission denied
journalctl shows: kernel: secureboot: signature verification failed for module cosign-verify-helper.efi
```
Also their hardware partner (EdgeBox vendor) says the device firmware enforces a vendor-signed module list and they won't produce a signed helper without a partnership MOU.

clare (Security): thanks @ana. two parallel tracks: 1) short-term: we can produce an offline verification artifact (signed manifest + detached signature) and a simple script that performs verification in userland without calling kernel module (cosign supports --keyless verification flow). That avoids installing helpers. 2) long-term: work with EdgeBox vendor to get the helper vendor-signed or provide an accepted shim.

devon (Eng-Platform): confirm: the marketplace requires OCI images to be signed by default. We can allow a per-customer override for air-gapped installs (flag in private deploy config) to accept pre-verified tarball imports with attached signatures. Implementation effort ~ a half-day to add an override and audit log.

sam (PartnerEng): RetailCo timeline is tight — they want to start acceptance testing tomorrow. Which option is fastest?

clare (Security): fastest is the offline verification script + signed manifest. We can generate a tarball for the images + signatures and a small verifier script (bash + openssl/cosign). They verify the checksums and signatures locally. No kernel module required. Risk: we need to document the trust path and have the customer's Sec team sign off.

ana (SI - Vertex): customer Sec is reachable but strict — they want evidence chain + recommendations for key rotation. Can we do an HSM-backed signing step?

devon (Eng-Platform): we can produce signatures signed by our integration key (HSM available in our private deploy pipeline). We'll export the public verification key and include rotation instructions. That adds a day for HSM ceremony documentation. For immediate test, we can use a short-lived key and rotate after go-live.

marketplace-bot: Marketplace rule check: "signed_images_required": true, "airgap_workaround": allowed with partner_approval.

sam (PartnerEng): ok plan: 1) @devon produce an image bundle + detached signatures and verification script by EOD today; 2) @clare prepare a one-page trust matrix and key rotation notes for customer review; 3) I'll draft a partner escalation to EdgeBox vendor requesting a vendor-signed verifier module — that can be medium-term.

clare (Security): will include suggested acceptance language RetailCo can use for their Sec to approve the offline flow. Also note: insist on pinning image digests in their deploy manifests and capturing the signature timestamps.

ana (SI - Vertex): RetailCo prefers the offline bundle. I'll coordinate on customer side to pull the bundle over to their air-gapped environment and run tests. Can we include a minimal systemd healthcheck unit so their ops team can smoke test post-import?

devon (Eng-Platform): yep — will add a systemd unit and a simple /health endpoint checker script. Also will include commands: ```
# load images
docker load -i redwood-connector-bundle.tar
# verify signature
./verify-bundle.sh redwood-connector-bundle.sig redwood-connector-bundle.tar
# start service
systemctl enable --now redwood-connector.service
```

sam (PartnerEng): thanks. make sure the bundle includes exact digests and the cosign logs. I'll update the SI runbook entry for "airgapped marketplace onboarding" to include this path and the EdgeBox escalation contact.

marketplace-bot: Ticket created: MP-2026-894 airgap image-signing workaround. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/MP-2026-894

ana (SI - Vertex): I'll relay to RetailCo that we'll deliver the bundle + verifier this afternoon and will schedule a call for the import window. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

clare (Security): one more ask — capture the customer's acceptance that they understand we're using a temporary signing key and will rotate it within 7 days of go-live. I'll draft the acceptance clause.

devon (Eng-Platform): done. PR incoming with bundle artifact instructions.

sam (PartnerEng): marking this thread as an implementation escalation and adding to the partnership handoff doc. :white_check_mark:
